verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TWAGALANE-; okwagala
Kwe kuva-eri Katonda:
Kale,ffe-abooluganda,
Tube nnyo n'okwagala.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Twali tulina-ebibi
Yesu n'afa ku muti:
Oyo gwe yafiirira,
Ffe tunaaakyawa tutya?

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Bonna ffe tubaagale,
Twagale-abatukyaye
N'abo abalina-ebibi
Twagalenga bwagazi.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Kale-ekisa mu myoyo
Kyakenga ng'omuliro;
Kyokere ddala byonna
Ebitali bya kisa.
